query_results.query: How does thermal management affect electric-aircraft motor power density?
query_results.answer: Thermal management affects electric-aircraft motor power density by augmenting battery power and allowing the fueled genset to recharge the battery, which can affect UAM electric logistics. The LNG hybrid system uses LNG to cool the co-located power electronics and genset generator, but LNG fuel still has residual cooling capacity after cooling the genset and aircraft power electronics and is not considered here to reduce other genset cooling requirements. Why are high-temperature sensors useful in electrified aircraft systems?
query_results.answer: High-temperature sensors are useful in electrified aircraft systems because they can monitor battery health, powertrain conditions, and hazardous materials, which are critical for safety and performance. They also help detect and warn of off-nominal conditions before they become catastrophic, and they can provide warnings before the aircraft reaches its limits. The sensors are fabricated on battery separators and can monitor battery cells, which are essential for managing the electrical and mechanical stresses in electrified aircraft.

query_results.query: What role can magnetic gearing play in an electric propulsion drivetrain?
query_results.answer: Magnetic gearing can eliminate lubrication, failure mechanisms, and reliability concerns of mechanical gears, and it can also have a reduced vibration signature due to lower mesh stiffness and expected lower variation in mesh stiffness. It is also recognized that magnets can transfer torque through magnetic forces without physical contact between gears.
